note: Decision days whose live forecast never reached users. Each is still scored, but flagged retro, so it is not a live day for the promotion rule, the demotion windows or the live-only monitor (ADR 075). Add a day only with evidence from the commit history of data/forecast.json.

days.2026-10-14: P3's forecast for this decision day (mode after_us_close, target the 2026-10-15 PM fix) is published each morning; it was due about 06:57 IST on 2026-10-15. The data-sync token had expired (HTTP 401) from about 13:00 UTC on 2026-10-14 to 07:33 UTC on 2026-10-15, so it was never published; users saw the hold forecast (after_morning_rate) from 13:03 IST instead.
days.2026-11-10: P3's forecast for this decision day (mode after_us_close, base_date 2026-11-10) was due after the 10 Nov US close, about 02:10 UTC on 2026-11-11. That check-price run (42944182557) wrote a Rs.0 headline from a rate stored as 0 and scripts/validate_data.py blocked the sync, so it was never published. Enumerated on 2026-11-14 from the commits of data/forecast.json on master (script mode_history.py): after bdacc25c (2026-11-07, mode after_us_close, base_date 2026-11-06) the next change of next_fix.mode is 19fa8420 (mode after_afternoon_rate, base_date 2026-11-11); no commit carries mode after_us_close with base_date 2026-11-10. Users saw a hold forecast.
days.2026-11-11: P3's forecast for this decision day (mode after_us_close, base_date 2026-11-11) was due about 03:17 UTC on 2026-11-12. That check-price run (43147224529) failed inside the live model (next_fix error: ZeroDivisionError, a stored fold with a price of 0) and wrote the plain hold (commit c58e2196, headline naive_flat_hold, next_fix.active false), so no P3 forecast was published. No commit of data/forecast.json on master carries mode after_us_close with base_date 2026-11-11 (same enumeration).
days.2026-11-12: P3's forecast for this decision day (mode after_us_close, base_date 2026-11-12) was due about 02:10 UTC on 2026-11-13. The live model was down from 2026-11-12 13:10 UTC to 2026-11-13 21:54 UTC (every run: next_fix error ZeroDivisionError; commits 6aa8af09 and the runs after it wrote naive_flat_hold with next_fix.active false) until fixes #3780 and #3784, so it was never published. The first commit with next_fix active again is 4458a8ce (mode after_afternoon_rate, base_date 2026-11-13). No commit carries mode after_us_close with base_date 2026-11-12.
